title: fix(pm): fleet-roster and mailbox-open page their reads in the script, not through gh --paginate --slurp
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6hfpTrgtTBiyXscg9Lfr1f)_

Fixes #25962

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` and `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` read lists through `gh api --paginate --slurp`, which the built-in gh of cloud sessions refuses. The fleet roster (#25462) could not be regenerated from a cloud seat.

- New `scripts/pm/gh-pages.mjs`: `readAllPages(path)` forces `per_page=100`, walks `page=1, 2, …` with plain `gh api <path>` until a short page, and returns an error (never a partial list) on a failed page, a non-list page, or more than 50 full pages. No `Link` header, the same rule as `board-snapshot.mjs`.
- Both scripts import it; `ghJson()` keeps its call shape, so no caller changes.
- Each `--self-test` gains the battery "paging: a three-page read through the loop equals the slurped array" (4 cases: 100+100+37 rows equal the slurped array flattened; the pages asked and kept query keys; an exact multiple stops after one empty page; a failed or non-list page is an error). Battery floor 7 → 8 in both.

No change to what the roster shows or its columns. No relay change. Publishes nothing, so `skip-changeset`.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` → 73 cases in 8 batteries pass; `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` → 44 cases in 8 batteries pass.
- With a fake `gh` first on PATH that refuses `--paginate` and `--slurp` and forwards everything else to the real CLI: the base commit exits 3 (`gh: --paginate is not supported…`), this branch exits 0 and its `--json` rows (22) equal the base commit's rows read with the real gh.
- `readAllPages` on `/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls?state=open` under the fake gh: 20 rows, the same count as `gh api --paginate --slurp`.
